title: The war machine at the crossing
note: Rivet fires across the zebra stripes as the war machine advances with its escort. The fifth offer highlights Gloria.

title: From bare claws to the hand cannon
note: The camera tracks Rivet through the alley and loading bay. The first clear highlights the electro baton.

title: Claw strike at cover
note: Rivet strikes a patrol cop at the corner of a black cover crate. Two fallen cops lie across the street.

title: The first upgrade
note: The three paper cards offer speed, Kerf and the electro baton. The cleared-wave HUD stays visible at upper left.

title: Under the viaduct
note: Rivet stands between four concrete piers. The elevated road ends and girder shadows frame the lane.

title: Market stalls
note: Two pale paved islands hold four umbrella carts and a newsstand. The centre lane stays open.

title: Crosswalk
note: The zebra runs between paired traffic signals. Opposing stop lines and a newsstand flank the crossing.

title: Alley neck
note: Short masonry wings narrow the asphalt. Four fallen cops lie on the road, including the pair beside the lower kerb.

title: Loading bay
note: Three tied cargo loads occupy a hatched apron in front of warehouse doors. Oil drums stand across the road.

title: Kiosk plaza
note: A coffee kiosk stands on a broad flagstone square, with planted beds and a street clock along the shopfront.

title: Barricade line
note: Three striped barriers stagger the route between the office frontage and the southern pavement.

title: Plain block
note: A bus shelter occupies a painted pull-in beneath the shopfronts. A bench faces it across the dashed road.

title: Health at 100, 50 and 10
note: Three live HUD crops show 210, 105 and 21 cream pixels against the same 210-pixel ink track.
